title: Exemptions leave with what they exempt
statement: Have a check fail on any exemption or known-fault entry that nothing current matches.
example: When branch replies landed in all 18 lessons, the check went red until its two now-fixed known-flat entries were deleted.
detail: In a Grade 3 reading build, a drift check exempted beats by label, and a second exemption, added the morning a new beat shipped, was dropped the same evening when that beat was removed: kept, it would have waved any later beat with that label through unexamined, so the rulebook holds that an exemption exists only for a label something currently produces and leaves with that label. The build keeps replies that are still flat in a named deferral table that may only shrink, since an assertion checks that every row is still flat: when branch replies landed in all 18 lessons, the gate went red until the two fixed rows were deleted, so a fixed defect became a required edit rather than a stale note. When image descriptions were reclassed as phrases, exempt from a sentence test, a doubled word planted inside the newly exempted text still failed, so the exemption did not become a silencer. A second learning from the same rulebook is kept here rather than in the statement: plant a fault inside each exemption to show that real faults there still fail, which the rulebook calls the check any exemption owes.

evidence.quote: An exemption is not a historical record — it is a live hole in
an exemption exists only for a label something currently
so the classification did not become a silencer
A fixed defect becomes a required edit rather than a stale note nobody re-reads.
